verdicts.reason: A is the square layout scaled and dropped into the middle of the tall canvas, with about 230px of empty space above the logo and below the content, so it was never rearranged into a vertical layout; still, the hierarchy, the headline/CTA sizes and the brand all survive and everything is readable. B does stack things vertically, but the 'Glow' headline, the 'Sparkling botanicals' tagline and the 'Shop Now' CTA have shrunk to tiny, barely legible sizes while the can takes over the whole canvas; the logo is a tiny scrap at the top right on a different axis from the left-aligned copy, and the elements float far apart with no grouping, so the hierarchy is broken.
